verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents a public REST API with OAuth 2.0 client-credentials auth, a Records API, a Workflows API (launch, bulk launch, interact with approvals), data-export jobs, and full webhook CRUD with signing. An llms.txt file and markdown docs are served, so it can be driven programmatically. Missing for 10: API access is gated behind a paid API add-on, no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the standard paths, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration.
